name: Tide Gauge House
note: strawberry-hill.ts tideGaugeHouse (2026-10-05; NOAA Greater Farallones 'Pier & Tide Gauge House'): the small white wooden house with a red roof at the end of the Coast Guard pier off Crissy Field, the oldest continuously operating tide gauge in the Western Hemisphere (1854). It stood alone on the water; the builder now draws the pier back to the shore by the sanctuary building. Was a brick-loft recipe.
